'''Emthuul''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gloorag]] who lived on [[Byrsym]] around the time of the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Emthuul owned a bar called [[Emthuul's]] and he worked as a bartender there. He tried not to get involved in interpersonal dealings and he had a reputation for staying neutral in disputes. However, he appreciated how difficult the Empire had made things for some people and he was willing to give shelter to those who were fleeing from it.
